# Architecture Configuration for LLMDD v8
ARCH=HEX,DI,DIP,NO_CROSS_LAYER,PORT_FLOW_OUT_IN,DOTENV_WALKUP,CODER_FEEDBACK,SEVERITY,ITR_LIFECYCLE,HARD_FAIL,VERIFICATION_CONTROL_LOOP
LAYER.ORDER=DOMAIN,APPLICATION,INFRASTRUCTURE,CONTROL
APP.NAME=llm-driven-design
APP.LANGUAGE=scala
APP.VERSION=8.0.0

# Symbol Definitions for LLMDD v8
SYS=LLMDDv8.0
MODE=DTR_BASELINE_X_CU_COMPILE

# Node Types
NODE.X=EXTRACTOR
NODE.DTR=DESIGN_TENSOR
NODE.DSG=DESIGNER
NODE.ADV=ADVISOR
NODE.ITR_COMPILER=ITR_COMPILER
NODE.COD=CODER
NODE.VER=CODE_LEAD (Verifier)
NODE.OUT=OUTPUT

# CU Types
CU_TYPE.REGULAR=RegularCU
CU_TYPE.ARCH=ArchCU
CU_TYPE.LEGEND=LegendCU
CU_TYPE.VERIFICATION=VerificationCU
CU_TYPE.E2E_VERIFICATION=E2eVerificationCU

# Required Parts
REQUIRED_PARTS=ARCH,LEGEND

# Severity
SEVERITY.CRITICAL=Stub instead of real implementation
SEVERITY.MAJOR=Feature implemented but differs from spec
SEVERITY.MINOR=Functional but differs in approach
SEVERITY.TRIVIAL=Documentation, comments, formatting

# Convergence
CONVERGENCE.MAX_E2E_REPAIR_ITERATIONS=3
CONVERGENCE.DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD=Tests get worse for 2 consecutive iterations

# Verification Tests for cu-001: System tensor v8 update

## Test Suite

set -e

echo "=== Testing System Tensor v8 Update ==="

grep -q "SYS=LLMDDv8.0" system_tensors/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr

echo "=== All tests passed ==="

# E2E Verification Tests for LLMDD v8

## Test Suite
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "=== E2E Testing LLMDD v8 Pipeline ==="

# Test 1: System tensor compiles
echo "Test 1: System tensor syntax valid"
! grep -qP "^\s+[^#]" system_tensors/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr

# Test 2: itr-compiler compiles
echo "Test 2: itr-compiler compiles"
cd itr-compiler && sbt compile && cd ..

# Test 3: Verifier agent exists
echo "Test 3: Verifier agent exists"
test -f .opencode/agents/verifier.md
grep -q "CODE_LEAD" .opencode/agents/verifier.md

# Test 4: Coder agent has escalation format
echo "Test 4: Coder agent has escalation format"
grep -q "STATUS=COMPLETED|ESCALATED" .opencode/agents/coder.md
grep -q "ESCALATION_REASON" .opencode/agents/coder.md

# Test 5: Architecture docs updated
echo "Test 5: Architecture docs updated"
grep -q "Verifier" .opencode/instructions/architecture.md
grep -q "LLMDDv8" .opencode/instructions/architecture.md

# Test 6: AGENTS.md updated
echo "Test 6: AGENTS.md updated"
grep -q "verifier" .opencode/instructions/AGENTS.md
grep -q "ESCALATION" .opencode/instructions/AGENTS.md

# Test 7: Memory.md updated
echo "Test 7: Memory.md updated"
grep -q "verifier.md" .opencode/instructions/memory.md
grep -q "LLMDDv8" .opencode/instructions/memory.md

# Test 8: All files consistent
echo "Test 8: All files consistent"
grep -q "NODE.VER" system_tensors/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr
grep -q "Verifier" .opencode/instructions/architecture.md
grep -q "verifier" .opencode/instructions/AGENTS.md
grep -q "verifier.md" .opencode/instructions/memory.md

echo "=== All E2E tests passed ==="

# Update system tensor from v7 to v8

CHANGES:
1. Version: SYS=LLMDDv7.0 -> SYS=LLMDDv8.0

2. Add NODE.VER definition:
NODE.VER=CODE_LEAD (Verifier)
NODE.VER_DESC=Smarter model Coder acting as code lead. Runs in parallel with implementation Coders. Monitors CU feedback for escalations. Performs fixes on escalated CUs. After all CUs: runs e2e tests, repairs cross-CU issues until convergence. Same agent type as COD, different model and responsibilities.

3. Update NODE.COD_DESC to include escalation:
NODE.COD_DESC=Receives compiled CU frames. Implements CUs in dependency order. Produces per-CU FEEDBACK files. If blocked: writes ESCALATION in feedback for code lead pickup. Commits once per task.

4. Add WORKFLOW.STEP6 (VERIFY_CUS) and WORKFLOW.STEP7 (E2E_VERIFY):
WORKFLOW.STEP6=VERIFY_CUS
WORKFLOW.STEP6_DESC=VER (code lead) monitors CU feedback in real-time. On ESCALATED status: reads escalation detail, performs fix, commits. Runs in parallel with COD(s). Never waits for all CUs to complete.

WORKFLOW.STEP7=E2E_VERIFY
WORKFLOW.STEP7_DESC=After all CUs implemented: VER runs full e2e test suite (written by ADV). If FAIL: analyzes cross-CU failures, repairs, re-runs. Loop until convergence or max iterations. Writes final verification report.

5. Update WORKFLOW.STEP5 (IMPLEMENT_CUS) description:
WORKFLOW.STEP5_DESC=COD receives compiled ITR directory. Implements CUs in dependency order. Writes per-CU FEEDBACK files. If blocked: writes ESCALATION in feedback. Commits code, CU frames, and feedback once per task.

6. Renumber WORKFLOW.STEP6 (ITERATE) -> WORKFLOW.STEP8:
WORKFLOW.STEP8=ITERATE
WORKFLOW.STEP8_DESC=Updated codebase is re-scanned by dtr-builder to produce a new baseline DTR. Cycle repeats.

7. Update FLOW:
FLOW=X>DTR>ADV X DSG>ITR_COMPILER>COD(s)+VER X VER>E2E>DTR
FLOW.ESCALATION=COD>FEEDBACK(ESCALATED)>VER>REPAIR>COMMIT
FLOW.E2E=COD(s)_DONE>VER>E2E_TESTS>VER(REPAIR_LOOP)>REPORT>DTR

8. Add RULE.VER section:
RULE.VER=CODE_LEAD,REPAIR_ESCALATIONS,E2E_CONVERGENCE
RULE.VER.MONITOR=Verifier monitors CU feedback files in real-time. On ESCALATED status: reads escalation detail, performs fix, commits. Never waits for all CUs to complete before acting.
RULE.VER.REPAIR=Verifier can modify any CU implementation. Never modifies test files - tests are written by ADV and are the contract. If a test appears wrong, Verifier notes it in report but does not modify it.
RULE.VER.E2E=After all CUs implemented: Verifier runs full e2e test suite. If FAIL: analyzes cross-CU failures, repairs, re-runs. Loop until convergence or max iterations.
RULE.VER.CONVERGENCE=Verifier tracks e2e repair iterations. On convergence: writes PASS report. On max iterations: writes DIAGNOSIS report. Report is informational - Designer is informed, not asked to act.
RULE.VER.REPORT=Final verification report includes: per-CU status (CONVERGED/REPAIRED/ESCALATED), e2e test results, repairs made, architecture compliance check, recommendation for next iteration.

9. Add CONVERGENCE section:
CONVERGENCE.MAX_E2E_REPAIR_ITERATIONS=3
CONVERGENCE.DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD=E2e tests get worse for 2 consecutive iterations -> STOP
CONVERGENCE.ESCALATION=On divergence or max iterations -> DIAGNOSIS report (informational, not actionable)
CONVERGENCE.STATE_FILE=<app>.convergence.json

10. Update ARCH.FEEDBACK.FIELDS to include escalation:
ARCH.FEEDBACK.FIELDS=CU_ID,CODER_NAME,DATE,CLARITY_RATING,AMBIGUOUS_LINES,MISSING_CONTEXT,TOO_MUCH_DETAIL,ARCHITECTURE_DEVIATION,ARCHITECTURE_DEVIATION.SEVERITY,TIME_TAKEN_MINUTES,AI_CREDITS_USED,COMMIT_MESSAGE,STATUS,ESCALATION_REASON,ESCALATION_DETAIL,VERIFICATION_RESULT,VERIFICATION_DETAILS

11. Update CU.FIELDS to include tests:
CU.FIELDS=ID,DTR_COORDINATES,CONTENT,TESTS,VERIFICATION,TIMESTAMP

12. Add CU.TESTS and CU.VERIFICATION sections:
CU.TESTS=Advisor-written test code for CU verification. Actual executable tests, not descriptions. Verifier runs these.
CU.VERIFICATION=Verification metadata: unit_tests path, integration_points, smoke check command.

# Create verifier.md agent definition

File: .opencode/agents/verifier.md

Frontmatter:
description: Code lead - monitors Coder feedback, picks up escalations, runs e2e tests, repairs cross-CU issues. Smarter model. Use for verification and e2e sessions.
mode: primary
permission:

  bash:

Content:
# Code Lead (Verifier)

You are the **Code Lead** in the LLMDD team. You are a Coder with a smarter model acting as code lead. Your role is to monitor implementation Coders, pick up escalations, and run e2e verification.

## Rules

This agent is governed by the system tensor at system_tensors/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr. Read this file at session start.

Key rules:
- CODE_LEAD - you are the senior Coder, monitors other Coders
- REPAIR_ESCALATIONS - pick up escalated CUs and fix them
- E2E_CONVERGENCE - run e2e tests until convergence
- TEST_INTEGRITY - never modify test files (tests are ADV's contract)
- NO_DESIGN_CHANGE - you implement fixes, not design changes

## Responsibilities

1. Monitor CU feedback files for ESCALATED status
2. Read escalation details and perform fixes
3. After all CUs: run e2e test suite
4. Repair cross-CU issues until convergence
5. Write final verification report

## Escalation Pickup

1. Check <app>.feedback/ for files with STATUS=ESCALATION
2. Read ESCALATION_REASON and ESCALATION_DETAIL
3. Analyze the issue
4. Fix the implementation
5. Update the feedback file with fix details
6. Commit the fix

## E2E Verification

1. After all CUs implemented, run e2e test suite
2. If tests fail: analyze cross-CU failures
3. Fix implementation issues
4. Re-run tests
5. Repeat until convergence or max iterations
6. Write final verification report

## Convergence Tracking

Track e2e repair iterations. On convergence: write PASS report. On max iterations: write DIAGNOSIS report with details.

# Update coder.md with escalation format

Changes to .opencode/agents/coder.md:

1. Add STATUS field to feedback format:
STATUS=COMPLETED|ESCALATED
(COMPLETED = CU done, ESCALATED = blocked, needs code lead)

2. Add ESCALATION fields to feedback format:
ESCALATION_REASON=<why you are blocked>
ESCALATION_DETAIL=<detailed description of the issue>

3. Add VERIFICATION fields to feedback format:
VERIFICATION_RESULT=PASSED|FAILED|NOT_RUN
VERIFICATION_DETAILS=<test results summary>

4. Update the feedback format example to include new fields:

CU_ID=cu-002
CODER_NAME=cod-2
DATE=2026-07-14
CLARITY_RATING=4
AMBIGUOUS_LINES=none
MISSING_CONTEXT=none
TOO_MUCH_DETAIL=none
ARCHITECTURE_DEVIATION=none
ARCHITECTURE_DEVIATION.SEVERITY=NONE
TIME_TAKEN_MINUTES=15
AI_CREDITS_USED=50
COMMIT_MESSAGE=Implemented cu-002: verifier agent
STATUS=COMPLETED
ESCALATION_REASON=none
ESCALATION_DETAIL=none
VERIFICATION_RESULT=PASSED
VERIFICATION_DETAILS=All tests pass

5. Add escalation rules:
- If you cannot complete a CU (blocked, missing dependency, etc.) set STATUS=ESCALATION in your feedback
- Write ESCALATION_REASON and ESCALATION_DETAIL explaining the issue
- The code lead (VER) will pick up escalations and perform fixes
- Do NOT commit if STATUS=ESCALATION - the code lead will commit

6. Update commit rules:
- If STATUS=COMPLETED: commit as before (code + frames + feedback)
- If STATUS=ESCALATION: do NOT commit - code lead will handle
